name: Jeld-Wen- 3307 Lakeport

nadir.desc: The property consists of a very large rectangular industrial building with a white flat roof and a smaller attached roof section|A paved parking lot sits at one end of the building|Additional paved yards and outdoor storage occupy the opposite end|Neighboring gray-roof plant buildings, process equipment, and silos sit on the same campus|A public road and railroad corridor run along one side|A golf course borders the opposite side of the campus.

alpha.desc: The front of the building faces a paved parking lot with marked spaces and a landscaped strip|The structure is a large white flat-roof industrial building with a visible entry area|Trees line the lot and street|Neighboring campus buildings and process equipment are visible beyond the lot|A public road and sidewalk run along the frontage.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows the long white roof mass and exterior wall|Process tanks and equipment sit against one section of the wall|Paved circulation and neighboring plant roofs are visible on the campus side|A parking lot and drive lanes sit at the front|Trees and smaller campus buildings occupy the near corner.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows the long exterior wall, overhead doors, and paved yards|Outdoor storage, wrapped materials, and parked equipment occupy the rear lot|Neighboring plant buildings sit beyond the yard|A road and open ground run along the outer edge|Circulation space is present along the rear wall.

delta.desc: The right side of the building faces a public road with a grass strip and trees along the wall|The paved parking lot is visible at one end|The attached lower roof section and outdoor storage yard are visible at the other end|Campus buildings and additional lots continue behind the structure.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from Lakeport Blvd into a paved parking lot at the front of the building and into yard lanes at the rear and sides. The site is a large flat-roof industrial building on a multi-building campus that includes process equipment, silos, and additional plant structures. A golf course and water body sit on one side of the campus. Pelican Elementary School and residential streets sit near the opposite end. Railroad tracks run along the far side of the corridor. The large roof and open lots provide staging space, though stored materials and neighboring buildings may limit movement in some yards.
